mismatches.ori_prompt: For a quick and efficient office workout, suggest a short routine.
mismatches.generic_prompt: Create a short and efficient office workout routine that can be done quickly during a work break.
mismatches.generic_response:
1. Squats: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and lower your body as if you were sitting down into a chair. Push through your heels to return to standing. Repeat for 10-15 reps.
2. Plank: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart. Hold your body in a straight line for 30-60 seconds.
3. Lunges: Step forward with one foot and lower your body until your back knee is almost touching the ground. Push through your front heel to return to standing. Repeat for 10-15 reps on each leg.
4. Bicep curls: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a pair of dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing forward. Bend your elbows to curl the dumbbells to your shoulders. Lower the dumbbells back to your sides and repeat for 10-15 reps.
5. Tricep dips: Sit on the edge of a chair or bench and place your hands on the edge with your fingers facing forward. Lower your body until your arms are bent at a 90-degree angle. Push through your hands to return to the starting position. Repeat for 10-15 reps.
6. Shoulder shrugs: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a pair of dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing forward. Shrug your shoulders up towards your ears, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower the dumbbells back to your sides and repeat for 10-15 reps.

Remember to warm up before starting the workout and cool down afterwards by stretching.
